Commentary.Commentary: We are back with the chase. The umpires are out in the middle followed by the players of Pakistan Women. Chamari Athapaththu is out with Vishmi Gunaratne to open for Sri Lanka Women. For Pakistan Women, Sadia Iqbal will open the attack with the ball.
... The Run Chase ...

The bowling from Sri Lanka Women wasn't that good to begin with and they were the second-best team at the end of the Powerplay. The bowlers though did tremendously in the middle phase and gave away just 36 runs and took 4 wickets in that period. Udeshika Prabodhani and Kavisha Dilhari took a couple each while others went wicketless. The surface will get better to bat on under the lights but Pakistan Women possess a good bowling line-up. Can Sri Lanka Women chase this down and advance to the finals or will it be Pakistan Women who'll defend this and meet their arch rivals for the title? We shall find out soon with the chase.

The Pakistan Women's innings started on a high as the openers were brilliant while they lasted. The pair of Gull Feroza and Muneeba Ali smashed 61 together and both perished in the same over to Udeshika Prabodhani. Nida Dar and Sidra Ameen then knitted a steady partnership of 30 runs but even they both departed in the same over to Kavisha Dilhari. Aliya Riaz and Fatima Sana combined for a crucial partnership of 41 right at the end and helped the side post a good enough total they could fight for.

It an Even Stevens at the halfway stage of the game with Pakistan Women posting 140 on board. Chamari Athapaththu at the toss said they'll feel happy to restrict the opponents to around 140 and they have managed to do so.

Commentary.Commentary: We are all in readiness now. The umpires are out in the middle followed by the players of Sri Lanka Women. For Pakistan Women, the duo of Gull Feroza and Muneeba Ali are out as the openers. For Sri Lanka Women, Inoshi Priyadharshani will bowl the first over.
We are down to pre-match formalities now. The team are out for their respective National Anthems. It is going to be the National Anthem of Sri Lanka first followed by that of Pakistan.

Pitch report - It is a really good batting pitch. Adds it is good to bowl on a length and too full is where it is easy to hit. Mentions the spinners will come into the game and you need to be brave with the bat against them.

The skipper of Pakistan Women, Nida Dar says tey are doing well as a unit and the batting has done well so she is okay with batting first. Adds that in the knockout games batting first is better as it doesn't create that scoreboard pressure on the side. Informs they are going unchanged.

The skipper of Sri Lanka Women, Chamari Athapaththu says they will bowl first as she has confidence that her bowlers could restrict the opponents to a low total. Mentions that they will be looking to restrict Pakistan Women to around 140. Says it is a batting-friendly surface and they'll stick to their plans and back their skills. Informs they are unchanged in this game.
Pakistan Women (Playing XI) - Gull Feroza, Muneeba Ali (WK), Sidra Ameen, Nida Dar (C), Omaima Sohail, Aliya Riaz, Fatima Sana, Syeda Aroob Shah, Tuba Hassan, Sadia Iqbal, Nashra Sandhu.

Sri Lanka Women (Playing XI) - Vishmi Gunaratne, Chamari Athapaththu (C), Harshitha Samarawickrama, Hasini Perera, Anushka Sanjeewani, Kavisha Dilhari, Nilakshika Silva, Inoshi Priyadharshani, Udeshika Prabodhani, Sugandika Kumari, Achini Kulasuriya.
TOSS - The coin lands in favor of Sri Lanka Women and their skipper Chamari Athapaththu opts to BOWL first.

Pakistan on the other hand, has also fared well so far, the only defeat in the tournament has come against India. They too have a lot of quality in their ranks but as a team, they have not been at their best in recent times. A lot of people would love to watch an India-Pakistan final but does Pakistan have it in them to beat a well-oiled Lankan side? Can they get revenge for the defeat in the last Asia Cup sem-final? We will find out in a bit. Stay tuned for the toss.

This is a repeat of the last Asia Cup's semi final where it was Sri Lanka who won a thrilling encounter and made it into the finals where they were beaten quite easily by the Indians. They were non-favourites then but have to say, they have gorwn a lot as a team in the last year or os and head into this encounter as favourites especially playing at home. They have a very capable leader in the form of Chamari Athapaththu and they are filled with quality youngsters and very good experienced players. They have been playing good cricket in the tournament so far and would love to topple Pakistan yet again in a knockout game.

The team which we expected to make it into the finals have sotrmed their way into it. India have beaten Bangladesh earlier on quite easily and are the first team to make it into the biggest game of the tournament. Now it i time to find out, which is the second team to do so? Is it going to be Pakistan or Sri Lanka? We will find out in the next few hours.
